pairs.summary: Nr2e3 and PAX6 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 5 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Hepatocyte; ...). Median lift 1.45x, typical spacing ~60 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
